simbolik.forge-path.description: The path to the forge executable. Simbolik uses forge to compile the smart contracts. If forge is not in the PATH, you can set the path here.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Never build the project automatically. This is useful when you're using `forge build --watch` to build the project.
Build the project when the source code changes (utilizes Foundry's built-in compiler cache).
Build the project before every debugging session.
simbolik.autobuild.description: Chose when Simbolik should build the project.

simbolik.auto-open-disassembly-view.description: If set to true, the debugger will automatically open the disassembly view when starting a debugging session.

simbolik.json-rpc-url.markdownDescription: JSON-RPC endpoint to use when the extension is **not** auto-starting a node (`#simbolik.auto-start-node#` is off), and for `attach` requests. When auto-start is on, launch sessions use a freshly started node on an ephemeral port and this value is ignored.

simbolik.sourcify-url.description: Attach requests use this Sourcify endpoint to download the source code of the debugged transaction.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Run the debug server in-process in the extension host (default). No socket; the bundled TypeScript server drives the session directly.
Spawn the bundled TypeScript server as a standalone Node process and connect over TCP. Useful for out-of-process/remote-host debugging and standalone testing.
simbolik.adapterMode.description: How the extension hosts the local Solidity debug server.

simbolik.auto-start-node.markdownDescription: Automatically start a fresh execution node (anvil or kontrol-node) for each launch debugging session, so debugging stays one click. Turn this off to debug against your own already-running node at `#simbolik.json-rpc-url#`.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Kontrol Node — the KEVM (K Framework) execution engine (default). Launched through Nix from `#simbolik.kontrol-node-dir#`.
Anvil — the Foundry EVM node. Requires [Foundry](https://getfoundry.sh) at `#simbolik.anvil-path#`.
simbolik.rpc-node-type.markdownDescription: Which execution node the extension auto-starts for launch debugging sessions. Defaults to `kontrol-node`; switch to `anvil` to run against the Foundry EVM instead.

simbolik.anvil-path.markdownDescription: Path to the `anvil` binary used to auto-start a node when `#simbolik.rpc-node-type#` is `anvil`. Defaults to `anvil` on your `PATH`; set an absolute path if it is installed elsewhere. Requires [Foundry](https://getfoundry.sh).

simbolik.kontrol-node-dir.markdownDescription: Directory of the provisioned `kontrol-node` engine used to auto-start a node when `#simbolik.rpc-node-type#` is `kontrol-node`. When empty, falls back to the `KONTROL_NODE_DIR` environment variable, then `/home/node/kontrol-node`. See `.devcontainer/setup-kontrol-node.sh`.

contractName.description: The name of the contract to debug.

methodName.description: The name of the method to debug.

file.description: The file containing the smart contract to debug.

txHash.description: The transaction hash to attach to.

jsonRpcUrl.description: The URL of the JSON-RPC server.

sourcifyUrl.description: The URL of the Sourcify server.

chainId.description: The chain ID of the network.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run esbuild-base -- --minify && npm run esbuild-server -- --minify
scripts.esbuild: npm run esbuild-base -- --sourcemap && npm run esbuild-server -- --sourcemap
scripts.build:dev: tsc -b tsconfig.packages.json && npm run compile && npm run esbuild-server -- --sourcemap
